inputs.text: [excited] Spy… no… saurus. [curious] "Spino," in Latin, means spine — like the tall spikes on its sail. And "saurus" means the li…
[hesitant] Wait, I know this one: the spined lizard.
[happily] Exactly, you got it before I finished! It lived in North Africa, [amazed] ninety-five million years ago.
[curious] What did it eat, with all those spikes?
[playful] Fish! [confident] Huge fish, as long as you and Dad put together.
